title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad - vendor reviews + policy TODOs
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence work

Context / goal:
- Pull together remaining evidence for auditor checklist (Type II). Deadline: 2024-11-01 for initial upload.
- Finish vendor attestation statuses and capture proofs/notes in evidence folder.
- Update a couple of internal policies (incident response + data retention) and create PRs for review.

Today (quick log)
- 09:15 - skim Auth0 and Okta attestation docs; flag gaps for SSO team.
- 10:00 - sync w/ Priya (15m) on encryption key rotation logs location. Action: Priya to share path + sample export.
- 11:30 - lunch + quick check on Datadog SOC2 page. Looks like they have Type II up to 2024-06. Need to capture cert snapshot.
- 14:00 - vendor review deep-dive: notes below.

To-do (priority ordered)
1) Evidence collection - blockers first
   - [ ] Get KMS rotation logs (customer key rotation) from infra: ask Aaron SRE for last 6 months exports. (JIRA-OPS-112)
   - [ ] Export service account MFA logs (are service accounts covered?) - open question. If not, note as compensating control.
   - [ ] Snapshot Datadog SOC2 cert and save to evidence folder (evidence/datadog/). Save filename with date.
   - [ ] Auth0/Okta: capture attestation docs + screenshot of tenant settings showing SSO enforce policies. If tenant screenshot not allowed, get support case reference.
   - [ ] Collect formal vendor agreements for any third-party that stores customer data (SaaS backups, analytics).

2) Vendor reviews - notes and next steps
   - Auth0 (identity):
     - Has SOC2 Type II (check cert date) but we need tenant-level config proof for SSO enforcement and session timeouts.
     - TODO: request support case to get exported tenant config or provide screenshots.
     - Risk note: service accounts created before MFA enforcement - list as gap.
   - Datadog (monitoring/logs):
     - Cert present through 2024-06. Need current snapshot and account admin list.
     - Verify retention limits and deletion evidence for logs containing PII (if any).
   - Sentry / Rollbar (error tracking):
     - Check if PII is redacted by default. If not, need proof of redaction rules or masking in pipeline.
   - Stripe (payments):
     - PCI/SOC artifacts - likely okay but capture merchant agreement + contact for attestation renewal date.

3) Policy TODOs (short drafts in progress)
   - Incident Response policy - draft updated section for "Evidence collection during incidents".
     - [ ] Add step for preserving forensic snapshots (S3 path + who owns).
     - [ ] Add retention schedule for incident artifacts (30/90/365 days).
   - Data Retention & Deletion policy - TODO:
     - [ ] Clarify logs retention vs backups (who owns policy enforcement).
     - [ ] Define PII minimization thresholds for telemetry.
   - Access Reviews cadence - need to document quarterly review process and sample reports.

Outstanding questions / follow-ups
- Are service accounts currently required to have 2FA? (Probably not.) If not, auditors will want a compensating control - suggestion: time-limited keys + scoped permissions + monitoring.
- Where do we store vendor attestation PDFs? (evidence/vendor-attestations/ in shared drive?) Confirm with Priya and add to control matrix.
- Who is canonical owner for Datadog admin lists? Tagging SRE (Aaron) but confirm in JIRA.

Quick notes to self
- Save all artifacts with structure: evidence/<control-id>/<vendor-or-system>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<artifact-type>.pdf
- In Confluence control matrix, add link to evidence files (use relative path + doc id).
- When I request exports, ask for csv AND screenshot for UI-only things. Screenshots help auditors.

Short checklist for tomorrow
- [ ] Confirm evidence folder path + permissions with Priya.
- [ ] Request KMS rotation export from Aaron.
- [ ] Snapshot Datadog cert + admin list.
- [ ] Draft incident response additions and create PR for review (assign to Evelyn).

References / links to copy into evidence notes
- Control matrix: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Control-Matrix
- Vendor list (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Vendor-Inventory
- Current infra PR where I made a note about KMS rotate export: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

Random thoughts / brainstorming
- Could we add a simple automation to snapshot vendor cert pages monthly and push to an S3 bucket for immutable evidence? Low-effort lambda that hits vendor public cert URL and stores html/pdf.
- Build a checklist template for each vendor that maps to our control matrix so evidence capture is repeatable.

Notes to include in auditor packet (once we collect)
- Short README per control: what artifact is, who generated it, time range covered, any gaps/compensating controls.

End of scratchpad.
notes_excerpt: (internal) snapshot vendor certs, ask Aaron for KMS exports, update IR + data retention
